title: actual-crypto-sync built-in tokens
description: tokens.yml (a map of chain to its tokens) or a chain file in tokens/ (a list of tokens). The tool checks more when it loads them: one native token per chain, unique symbols and contracts, and valid addresses. See docs/development.md.

index.description: tokens.yml: each chain's list of tokens, inline or as !import tokens/<chain>.yml.

import.description: !import <path>: relative to tokens.yml, a .yml or .yaml file, with no . or .. segment.

list.description: A chain's tokens: exactly one native token (no contract), and its contract tokens.

symbol.description: Upper-case letters and digits, as the notes show it.

contract.description: The address of the token contract. Leave it out for the native token.

decimals.description: The on-chain decimals of the raw balance.

display_decimals.description: The decimals in the notes; at most decimals. Default: decimals, at most 8.

price_ids.description: The id of the token at each price provider; at least one.
